newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen gunmen kidnap local Arab Bank manager.
newsitem.headline: Yemen gunmen kidnap local Arab Bank manager.

text.p: Gunmen have kidnapped the Yemeni manager of Arab Bank, apparently because of a dispute with a tribal leader, a bank official said on Monday.
Ahmad al-Odeini, assistant manager for the bank's branch in Sanaa, was abducted a week ago by a group of armed men outside his house in the Yemeni capital Sanaa, the official said.
"It appears he was kidnapped because of a professional dispute involving him and a client who is a trader and a well-known sheikh from a local tribe," he said.
The official gave no further details.
The bank's employee union ordered his immediate release and threatened to take measures including halting work at the Jordan-based bank's seven branches across Yemen.
Kidnappings of foreigners is a common ploy by tribesmen with grievances against the government or foreign oil firms operating in Yemen, one of the Arab world's poorest states.
Odeini's abduction was the second reported incident involving a Yemeni hostage.
